4/ He takes the phone. Slowly. In full view. Because a thing taken slowly from a man who lets you is worth more than a thing grabbed.
5/ The phone is never recovered. Neither is the call log that would say who briefed the retrieval. The sack that crossed the back lawn was never inventoried either.
